answer.text:
According to Levi Strauss & Co.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 1, 2024:

* **Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses:** **$3,246.2 million**
* **Percentage of net revenues:** **51.1%**

### Calculations and Context:
* **Net revenues:** $6,355.3 million
* **SG&A expenses:** $3,246.2 million
* **Calculation:** 
  $$\frac{\$3,246.2\text{ million}}{\$6,355.3\text{ million}} \approx 51.0786\% \rightarrow 51.1\%$$

*(Source: Accession `0000094845-25-000005`, Section: `Filing Summary`, Chunks `da80ad4b-2f94-5f0c-a589-c296c250a006` and `7800a9af-162a-5e50-b146-b4ba64b4b763`)*
